resources.title: The PERFECT Marvel Rivals Beginners Guide!
resources.creator: Dazs
resources.noteEs: Guia completa de 30+ minutos para tu primer dia: como funciona el juego, los modos, los tres roles y los fundamentos que necesitas antes de entrar a tu primera partida. Ideal si nunca tocaste un hero shooter.
resources.noteEn: A 30+ minute all-in-one guide for day one: how the game works, the modes, the three roles and the fundamentals you need before your first match. Ideal if you've never touched a hero shooter.

resources.title: Marvel Rivals ULTIMATE Beginners Guide, Tips & Tricks!
resources.creator: Arekkz Gaming
resources.noteEs: Repaso ordenado de tips y trucos esenciales para arrancar: seleccion de heroe, team-ups, objetivos y errores comunes. Evergreen para entender la base del juego desde cero.
resources.noteEn: A clean rundown of essential starting tips and tricks: hero selection, team-ups, objectives and common mistakes. Evergreen for grasping the game's foundation from scratch.

resources.title: 10 Mistakes New Players in Marvel Rivals
resources.creator: mstz bootman
resources.noteEs: Recorre los 10 errores mas comunes de principiantes (positioning malo, perseguir kills, guardar el ultimate de mas) y como corregirlos. Util para dejar de perder partidas por habitos basicos.
resources.noteEn: Walks through the 10 most common beginner mistakes (bad positioning, chasing kills, hoarding your ultimate) and how to fix them. Useful for stopping losses caused by basic habits.

resources.title: 100 Marvel Rivals Tips and Tricks - LEARN EVERYTHING
resources.creator: Esidi
resources.noteEs: Cien tips rapidos que cubren settings, mecanicas escondidas, interacciones de heroes y trucos de mapa. Buena segunda parada cuando ya conoces lo basico y quieres detalles que la mayoria ignora.
resources.noteEn: One hundred quick tips covering settings, hidden mechanics, hero interactions and map tricks. A great second stop once you know the basics and want details most players miss.

resources.title: Marvel Rivals Black Cat Best Crosshair Settings & Beginner Ability Tips
resources.creator: Marvel Rivals Merchant
resources.noteEs: Ejemplo concreto de como aprender un heroe nuevo desde cero: crosshair recomendado, settings y uso basico de habilidades de Black Cat. Te muestra el flujo que aplica a cualquier personaje que recien empieces.
resources.noteEn: A concrete example of learning a new hero from scratch: recommended crosshair, settings and basic ability usage for Black Cat. Shows you the workflow that applies to any character you're just picking up.
